mapper.select: SELECT H.HOUSE_SN, H.PRTNR_SN, H.HOUSE_NM, H.HOUSE_STTS_CD, H.ZIP, H.ADDR, H.DADDR, H.HOUSE_DC, H.ADULT_ADD_CHRG_AMT, H.CHILD_ADD_CHRG_AMT, H.INFANT_ADD_CHRG_AMT, H.WEEKDAY_RATE_AMT, H.FRIDAY_RATE_AMT, H.SATURDAY_RATE_AMT, H.PEAK_RATE_AMT, H.CLOSED_WKDAY_CD, H.HOLIDAY_CLOSED_YN, H.LUNAR_HOLIDAY_CLOSED_YN, H.CHKIN_TIME, H.CHKOUT_TIME, H.LATE_CHKOUT_TIME, H.RSVT_CNFIRM_CD, H.CNCL_RFND_PLCY_CN, H.PBTRNSP_GUIDE_CN, H.NOTICE_CN, H.REG_DT, H.MDFCN_DT, P.CONM AS PRTNR_CONM, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM R WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = H.HOUSE_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N') AS ROOM_CNT, (SELECT HI.ATCH_FILE_SN FROM HOUSE_IMAGE HI WHERE HI.HOUSE_SN = H.HOUSE_SN AND HI.DEL_YN = 'N' AND HI.RPRS_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS RPRS_ATCH_FILE_SN FROM HOUSE H JOIN PRTNR_MST P ON P.PRTNR_SN = H.PRTNR_SN WHERE H.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT HOUSE_SN, PRTNR_SN, HOUSE_STTS_CD, DEL_YN FROM HOUSE WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} FOR UPDATE
SELECT HOUSE_STTS_CD FROM HOUSE WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT H.HOUSE_SN, H.HOUSE_NM, H.HOUSE_STTS_CD, H.ADDR, H.REG_DT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM R WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = H.HOUSE_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N') AS ROOM_CNT FROM HOUSE H
ORDER BY H.HOUSE_SN DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update:
UPDATE HOUSE SET HOUSE_NM = #{houseNm}, ZIP = #{zip}, ADDR = #{addr}, DADDR = #{daddr}, HOUSE_DC = #{houseDc},
SIDO_REGION_CD = CASE WHEN #{sidoRegionCd} IS NULL THEN SIDO_REGION_CD ELSE #{sidoRegionCd} END, SIGUNGU_REGION_CD = CASE WHEN #{sidoRegionCd} IS NULL THEN SIGUNGU_REGION_CD ELSE #{sigunguRegionCd} END, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND PRTNR_SN = #{prtnrSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

UPDATE HOUSE SET ADULT_ADD_CHRG_AMT = #{adultAddChrgAmt}, CHILD_ADD_CHRG_AMT = #{childAddChrgAmt}, INFANT_ADD_CHRG_AMT = #{infantAddChrgAmt}, CHKIN_TIME = #{chkinTime}, CHKOUT_TIME = #{chkoutTime}, LATE_CHKOUT_TIME = #{lateChkoutTime}, RSVT_CNFIRM_CD = #{rsvtCnfirmCd}, CNCL_RFND_PLCY_CN = #{cnclRfndPlcyCn}, PBTRNSP_GUIDE_CN = #{pbtrnspGuideCn}, NOTICE_CN = #{noticeCn}, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND PRTNR_SN = #{prtnrSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select:
SELECT H.HOUSE_SN, H.PRTNR_SN, H.HOUSE_NM, H.HOUSE_STTS_CD, H.ADDR, H.REG_DT, H.MDFCN_DT, P.CONM AS PRTNR_CONM, (SELECT U.USER_NM FROM USER_ACNT U WHERE U.USER_SN = H.RGTR_SN) AS CREATOR_NM, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM R WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = H.HOUSE_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N') AS ROOM_CNT, (SELECT HI.ATCH_FILE_SN FROM HOUSE_IMAGE HI WHERE HI.HOUSE_SN = H.HOUSE_SN AND HI.DEL_YN = 'N' AND HI.RPRS_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS RPRS_ATCH_FILE_SN FROM HOUSE H JOIN PRTNR_MST P ON P.PRTNR_SN = H.PRTNR_SN
ORDER BY H.HOUSE_SN DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HOUSE WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND SIDO_REGION_CD IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE HOUSE SET HOUSE_STTS_CD = 'SUSPENDED', MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND HOUSE_STTS_CD <> 'SUSPENDED'
UPDATE HOUSE SET HOUSE_STTS_CD = 'HIDDEN', MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND HOUSE_STTS_CD = 'SUSPENDED'
